purpose: Decodes and validates an EMV merchant-presented-mode (MPM) QR payload against a pluggable national scheme profile - generic EMV MPM, Fiji FJQR, or Brazil Pix BR Code - covering TLV structure, duplicate and trailing-object detection, the CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE checksum over the payload including the literal 6304 (with a dedicated rule for the common generator bug that excludes it), point-of-initiation static versus dynamic semantics, merchant-account templates 26-51 and their globally unique identifiers, MCC, ISO 4217 currency, amount and tip/convenience consistency, merchant name and city presence and length, additional-data subfield structure, and for Pix dynamic payloads the location-URL shape and the JWS protected-header skeleton (alg allowed set, kid, jku) without any signature verification. Zero network and zero PII echo: merchant name, city, postal, additional-data values and account identifiers are reported as tag/length/verdict only, never echoed; a dynamic payload URL is never fetched. Exclusions: no signature or key verification, no QR image decoding (payload string only), no scheme-operator endorsement implied; the FJQR profile cannot verify scheme-specific account GUIDs because the FJQR technical specification's GUI registry is not public (advisory only).
